rule: sin --transport el servicio no arranca (exit 2) y no hay fallback al endpoint publico; 'local' exige WS loopback

no_transport.stderr: {"service": "market-stream-service/v1", "error": "TRANSPORT_CONFIG", "detail": "transporte no especificado: use --transport local --base-url ws://127.0.0.1:<puerto> o --transport public (conexion publica explicita)"}

local_without_base_url.stderr: {"service": "market-stream-service/v1", "error": "TRANSPORT_CONFIG", "detail": "transporte local sin --base-url: no se usa el endpoint publico como respaldo"}

local_public_url.stderr: {"service": "market-stream-service/v1", "error": "TRANSPORT_CONFIG", "detail": "--base-url no es un WS loopback valido: 'wss://fstream.binance.com' (se espera ws://127.0.0.1:<puerto>)"}

local_remote_host.stderr: {"service": "market-stream-service/v1", "error": "TRANSPORT_CONFIG", "detail": "--base-url no es un WS loopback valido: 'ws://192.168.1.10:8799' (se espera ws://127.0.0.1:<puerto>)"}

base_url_without_transport.stderr: {"service": "market-stream-service/v1", "error": "TRANSPORT_CONFIG", "detail": "transporte no especificado: use --transport local --base-url ws://127.0.0.1:<puerto> o --transport public (conexion publica explicita)"}
